items.t: Sorry, I didn't mean to cut you off.
items.z: 抱歉，我不是有意打断你。

items.t: My bad, that was totally on me.
items.z: 我的错，完全是我的问题。

items.t: I owe you one.
I really appreciate you doing that.
items.z: 真的很感谢你做了这件事。

items.t: That's so kind of you.
Would you mind if I opened the window?
Could I ask you a quick favor?
Sorry to bother you, but do you have a minute?
items.z: 不好意思打扰一下，你有时间吗？

items.t: No worries at all.
Don't mention it.
I'm sorry for your loss.
I hope I'm not overstepping, but…
Thanks for being so understanding.
Sorry, I'm going to have to pass this time.
Excuse me, I think you dropped this.
items.z: 打扰一下，我想这是你掉的。

items.t: Let me get the door for you.
After you.
I didn't catch that. Could you say it again?
items.z: 我没听清，能再说一遍吗？

items.t: Thanks for your patience.
It means a lot.
